references.reading: In these worlds the truth changes 1.75 (ho-sparse) and 3.30 (ho-busy) times per cycle against a budget of 2 and 3 tasks, and 14 % and 17 % of subjects are never covered by the owner's research in any configuration (coverage 0.861 and 0.831), so no budget-bound loop holds its cycle-0 level: decay is partly the world's design. The loop's gain over no loop (+0.057, +0.073) is about half of what a blind round-robin of the same budget that reads each look's majority value gains over a perfect snapshot never refreshed (+0.115, +0.134; ratio 0.49 and 0.55); the shortfall is the product's (contested refreshes that never revise; the due order). The references read the world directly; they are not product configurations.

activity.reading: what each mechanism did (its own records; strategy selection's rankings) and the cycles in which what was investigated or held differs from the baseline's run of the same world and seed (the world is written whole before the run, so both met the same pages)

held_out.reading: rule (a) needs a paired gain above the baseline's between-seed sd in every world; with these seeds a gain below that sd cannot pass it, and 'no evidence' does not exclude a gain of that size; the paired noise (sd of the paired differences) is much smaller
